# Sentence bank for the stress tier's synthetic meetings (TESTING.md §14.2). One sentence per line; text only.
# test/meeting.js voices them with macOS `say -v Ioana` on the test computer (cached, never committed).
# Sentences of one or two words are short replies: used as back-channel, not judged for accuracy.
